poll.source_locator: Q11: ...race was between Democrat Bob Brooks and Republican Ryan Mackenzie, who would you vote for? Bob Brooks 49%, Ryan Mackenzie 43%, Neither/Other (Vol) 3%, Not sure (Vol) 5%; telephone survey of 529 likely voters, October 6-15, 2026, MOE +/-5%
poll.notes: Headline ballot is Q11 without leaners. Q12 (leaners, asked only of Q11 'not sure'): Brooks 18%, Mackenzie 33%, Not sure 49%; not folded in. Release page dated 2026-10-29 (article:published_time); full PDF linked at https://www.muhlenberg.edu/wp-content/uploads/7thDist_2026_final_LB.pdf (not fetched). Interviewing by Communication Concepts of Easton, PA. NEW pollster_id.
